row.stop_reason: No exercise contrast exists. The only factor is diet treatment (rosiglitazone 6 vs control 6, characteristics_ch1.1.treatment; S4.6.p1). Every mouse was sedentary apart from treadmill/rotarod/grip phenotyping tests given to both groups (S4.7-S4.9), so exercise is neither a factor nor separable from anything. The requested estimand (effect of exercise on gene expression) is not identifiable; the paper's own rosiglitazone-vs-control contrast does not answer the request and is not run as a substitute.
